question: T10: JavaScript let, undefined and export default, past the earlier read limit; the marks at the corners of a focused editor
answer: JavaScript: let, export, default, const, import, from, var, void, null, function and return are keywords in rgb(119, 0, 136); undefined is plain; n after export default is plain; a name after let, const, var or function is blue, and so is d in import d from; the string is red and numbers are rgb(17, 102, 68). Only import followed by a bare name is read: import {a} is unread. Corners: .cm-editor.cm-focused has an outline 2px solid rgb(14, 14, 14), and one pixel of it shows at the top left, rgb(157, 157, 157), top right and bottom right, rgb(104, 104, 104), none at the bottom left. With the focus away the corners read 247 and 250, ignored as too faint to tell from the panel.
